concept: Quiet relational hurt — a woman in solitary reflection at sunset

generation.description: A cinematic sunset vista shows a lone young woman curled up on a rugged rock at the left foreground, her face hidden, wearing a soft neutral sweater, dark pants, and pale sneakers as she gazes downward in quiet solitude. Beyond her, a hazy valley and reflective lake stretch toward layered mountains beneath glowing peach-and-gold clouds, with warm rim light on her hair and clothing, cool shadows, and an atmosphere that feels peaceful yet deeply melancholic.
